checks.message: Repository-provided provisional boundary is disclosed and does not block content scoring; recalculate the entire package when an official polygon is supplied.
Three required key-area geometries are provisional, prominently disclosed, and eligible for concept scoring; replace and recalculate when official polygons are supplied.
Conceptual land-use polygons remain topologically valid inside the submitted provisional boundary and are not represented as surveyed or statutory data.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
